Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:管理员改不了已安装包里的权限集时,提示里的按钮名改成界面上真实显示的「新建类似」;保存元数据被拒时,空键名不再显示成一对空引号,四五个字母的错键不再被乱猜成无关的键;命令行输错子命令时会指向对应的帮助;接入 MCP 的文档改正了撤回审批被拒时的返回码。
- 为什么做:来自上一版全面走查记下的五条提示与文档问题,其中「流程引用环境里的流程」那条此前已修好,本次核实后未改。
- 出错会怎样:只改提示文字、帮助指引和文档,什么能存、什么被拒一律不变;有问题回退本 PR 即可。
- 要你做什么:在随后的决策卡上决定,视图保存被拒时附带的那条笼统「输入无效」条目是删掉、改写还是保留。

## What changes

Five rows from the v18.4.0 sweep ledger (comment 6881136418 on #32908). Each was re-measured on `origin/main` at `c05a8a01c9`; one was already fixed and one sub-item is held for a decision. Nothing new is accepted or refused.

- **Row 130, packaged permission sets (the `ITEM_LOCKED` sentence).** The save door's regime-C row (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/packaged-base-regime.ts`) and plugin-security's `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` lock refusals (`packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`: the diagnostic and both end-user texts, 11 locales) sent the admin to a "Clone" action. Measured in the console source: both entry points, Studio's Access pillar (`access-new-similar`) and Setup's permission matrix, draw `perm.clone.action`, which is "New similar" in `en` and "新建类似" in `zh`; the designer strings ship only those two, so every other language shows the English label, and a Traditional Chinese session shows the Simplified catalogue. Each text now names the control that way. The two docs pages that quote the sentence (`concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`, `permissions/authorization.mdx`) follow it.
- **Row 60, unknown-key refusal (`packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts`, `strictUnknownKeyError`).** Two of its three sub-items are fixed here:
  - an empty key rendered as empty backticks; it now reads "an empty key (`""`)", and no rename is guessed for it (any declared key of two letters or fewer was within budget);
  - below six characters the rename budget is the floor of 2, which exists for a swap of two adjacent letters; it also admitted two unrelated edits, so a removed `app.aria` was answered "Did you mean `aria` → `areas`?". A short key's guess must now be one edit away, counting an adjacent swap as one (`lable` → `label`, `aeras` → `areas`, `labl` → `label` are still offered). Keys of six characters or more are scored exactly as before.
  - **Held, not changed:** the sibling `{ path: '', message: 'Invalid input', code: 'invalid_union' }` entry on a view or form refusal. It is pinned as `issues[0]` by #5364's "strictly additive" rule (`protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`), and Studio parses its exact text (`translateValidationMessage` maps "invalid input" to its localized "Invalid"). Dropping or rewording it changes a recorded envelope rule, so it goes to a decision. It is split out to its own card, #35400, nested under #33345, so this PR closes the rest of the card.
- **Row 164, CLI unknown command.** `os environments frobnicate` answered `command environments:frobnicate not found` and nothing else; `os frobnicate` the same. A `command_not_found` hook (`packages/cli/src/hooks/command-not-found/point-at-help.ts`, registered in `package.json` `oclif.hooks`) keeps the hard error, exit 2 and no suggester, spells the id as typed, and ends with the help of the deepest topic or command the words reached, matching the `See more help with --help` tail a wrong flag already gets.
- **Row 233, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`.** The recall/resubmit paragraph said anyone else is refused `FORBIDDEN`. Measured in `ApprovalService.refuseUnreadableRequest` and the approvals route's status table: a caller who cannot read the request gets `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` (as for an id that names no request); one who can read it gets `403 FORBIDDEN`. The doc now says both.
- **Row 108, dropped: already fixed.** The environment-only holder has had its own remedy since `40c73a8f4f` ("No package holds it, so no dependency reaches it: move the flow into …"), pinned by `[#32967] an environment-only holder` in `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`. That sentence is absent at the QA run's `ee9ad834` and present at the ledger's `87330e89`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33345-sweep-refusal-copy.md`: `patch` on spec, metadata-protocol, plugin-security and cli.
- No `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` item quotes a changed sentence: `cli.flag-command-error-ux` still holds ('command … not found', exit nonzero), and the one item naming "the Clone action" (`access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle`) is retired.

## Tests

Final head `111a0f32d8`. One red-then-green pin per code row, at its producer:

- Row 60: `packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.test.ts`, new top-level describe `short and empty unknown keys` (4 cases).
- Row 130: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, new top-level describe (every locale of both refusals names the console label, plus the diagnostic); the exact-sentence pins in metadata-protocol and rest now read "New similar".
- Row 164: `packages/cli/src/hooks/command-not-found/point-at-help.test.ts` (unit tier, 4 cases).

- spec test: Test Files 856 passed (856), Tests 27371 passed, 1 todo; typecheck exit 0, check:test-typecheck OK
- metadata-protocol test: Test Files 358 passed, 9 skipped; Tests 23218 passed, 45 skipped; typecheck exit 0
- plugin-security test: Test Files 279 passed; Tests 6997 passed, 45 skipped; typecheck exit 0
- cli unit tier: Test Files 430 passed; Tests 6144 passed; typecheck exit 0. The integration tier is CI's (no spawn entry or integration file touched).
- rest: `rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts` 11 passed

The head then moved by one commit (`111a0f32d8`, a module-top lint preload in one edited metadata-protocol test, which `check:test-source-alias` asked for); that file re-ran green: 54 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the tests import the source by relative path, so no dist leg)</summary>

- Row 164: hook returns oclif's old message, so 3 of 4 fail; restored, blob 6143c7f48663 equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Row 60 screen: guess back to plain `findClosestMatches`, so the `aria` case fails (1 failed, 3 passed); restored, blob a4defaac58e7 equals HEAD.
- Row 60 empty key: renderer back to backticks, so the empty-key case fails; restored, blob a4defaac58e7 equals HEAD.
- Row 130: en user text back to "Clone action", so the en case fails (1 of 31); the regime row back to `"Clone"`, so 3 metadata-protocol pins fail; both restored, blob equals HEAD.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts` is a `packages/spec/src` non-test producer, so an L2 contract record is owed before the queue.
- Same family, not changed here: the `max(2, len/3)` budget is copied in `data/object.zod.ts` (`suggestKey`), `data/seed.zod.ts`, `data/field-value.zod.ts` and `data/default-value-shape.ts`, which this PR does not touch. A long retired key can still be guessed into a declared one: form `defaultSort` gets "Did you mean `defaultSort` → `defaults`?" (distance 3, budget 3).
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.security-permission-set-overlay-discard-retired.ts` still says "(the Clone action)" in a released migration note; left as released.
- Live CLI output at the final build: `os frobnicate` gives "command frobnicate not found / See more help with `os --help`", exit 2; `os environments frobnicate` points at `os environments --help`, exit 2; `os plugin trust frobnicate` points at `os plugin trust --help`; `os migrate plan --frobnicate` is unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (local, final head 111a0f32d8)</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 133 families derived; all 133 run, each exit 0. `--ran` reports "133 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 133 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".
- `overlap-check --branch=claude/issue-33345-sweep-refusal-copy`: VERDICT clean exit 0 (origin/main, #35261, #35129, #34717 merge cleanly).
- Local-only: `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0. `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 because the workspace is not fully built (35 ui/example packages have no dist); that is a reading of this box, not of the diff.
- Dogfood: n/a (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm). `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's.
</details>

## 席位核对

- Read first: `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts` (`shortKeyScreenedGuess`, `renderUnknownKey`), `packages/cli/src/hooks/command-not-found/point-at-help.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.ts` (locale texts).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/shared/strict-object.test.ts` should show the four `short and empty unknown keys` cases green.
